decisions.reason: ServiceDatabaseAdmission.java.verify owns an original PreparedStatement; this Error body catch records the identical primary then immediately rethrows it so its owning finally can directly close exactly once and resolve a second failure. Removing the catch would leave primary unrecorded and let a close failure incorrectly replace unknown body identity. This is not broad normalization of provider failures. The retained table is: no primary => original cleanup propagates; known SQL body with unknown cleanup => original cleanup; unknown body => same body with a newly fixed redacted secondary; SQL/SQL => fixed outer SQLException normalization. Same throwable is never added to itself. The outer catch accepts only SQLException; unknown Runtime/NPE/Error never becomes a normal result. Nested row cleanup precedes statement cleanup; early returns still execute finally. This classification concerns this catch syntax only and is independent of the previous CloseResource observations.
